Crawling a page with no links returns only the seed page

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"max_depth\":2}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.crawl_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(length(result.pages))
```
